name: print-social-built-different-fitness-posts-grey-blue-and-maroon
title: 'Built different.' fitness pack in grey-blue with maroon type, tape strips and big dates
whatItIs: Nine grey-blue square posts with heavy maroon lowercase headlines ('built different.', 'weekly workout', 'build & gain'), greyscale gym photos held by red tape strips, diagonal hatch marks, dot grids, plus signs and large white 'Aug 28' dates.
whatItMeans: Gritty and zine-like; tape and hatching feel handmade, motivating without gloss.
techniques: Stick greyscale photos with coloured tape strips.
Set lowercase heavy headlines for a casual voice.
Add hatch marks and plus signs as texture.
Anchor each post with a large date.

vocabulary.definition: A graphic of sticky tape holding an image.
Parallel diagonal lines used as texture.
